description: Workflow Health safely executes validation cases through Browser Automation Studio and records evidence without allowing unsafe mutation.

requirements.title: Execute Validation Cases Through BAS
requirements.description: When validation requests include execution, workflow-health must invoke Browser Automation Studio by workflow file with project root, execution options, seed parameters, and deterministic output directories, then ingest timeline, screenshot, video, console, network, page-error, metric, and status artifacts.

validation.notes: Execution service tests use a BAS client fake to assert request shape, artifact ingestion, metrics, status mapping, and failure finding generation.
A harmless observer BAS case runs through workflow-health and produces inspectable artifact references.

requirements.title: Fail Closed for Unsafe Mutation
requirements.description: Mutating workflow execution must be refused before any BAS call unless the catalog proves safety metadata, explicit confirmation policy, routed isolation, and seed/reset consistency for the selected assets.

validation.notes: Safety policy tests assert missing metadata, missing routed isolation, or reset conflicts return blocker findings and no BAS execution call.
A routed mutating fixture proves the primary database is not touched when mutation is allowed.

title: Safe BAS execution
